_readme: Third-party assets vendored into docs/ verbatim. This is a static
GitHub Pages site (unlike modules/src/vendor/, which exists because a
deployed box fetches modules/agent-box.nix as ONE file and its pages
load no external asset - neither constraint applies here), so vendoring
is a deliberate choice, not a requirement: keeping the hashing library
that computes WebPasswordHash (issue #25) in the repo, pinned by hash,
means the launch page's security-critical crypto is reviewable in the
same diff as everything else and never silently changes underneath a
Each file is byte-identical to the artifact at `url`, so `sha256` is
upstream's own hash and anyone can re-derive it
(`curl -sSL <url> | sha256sum`). Never edit a vendored file in place -
a local patch makes the pin unverifiable. Bump by re-running that curl
against a newer tag and updating both the file and this pin together.

packages.name: hash-wasm-argon2id
packages.used_by: docs/index.html, to compute the Argon2id WebPasswordHash client-side (issue #25)
packages.note: UMD build of hash-wasm's argon2id-only entry point (a WASM binary inlined as base64, no separate .wasm fetch). Exposes a global `hashwasm.argon2id({password, salt, parallelism, iterations, memorySize, hashLength, outputType}) -> Promise<string>`. Verified against a real Caddy `basic_auth argon2id` block (a hash-wasm-produced hash authenticates correctly and a wrong password is rejected) before vendoring.
